toaster-dash.title: Toaster Dash: Fast-Paced Baking Adventure
toaster-dash.slogan: Adventure in the world of cakes!
toaster-dash.description: Toaster Dash offers a thrilling fast-paced action game where you control a lightning-fast toaster. With adorable graphics and engaging gameplay, Toaster Dash promises ultimate entertainment. Avoid obstacles, collect ingredients, and upgrade your toaster to become a master chef. Ready to toast it up?

HomeFeatures.whatIsDescription: Toaster Dash is a fast-paced action game where you control a lightning-fast toaster. Avoid obstacles, collect ingredients, and upgrade your toaster to become a master chef.
HomeFeatures.howToPlayStep1: Move the toaster right, left, up, or down to perform different tasks.
HomeFeatures.howToPlayStep2: Avoid obstacles like forks, spiked donuts, and more.
HomeFeatures.howToPlayStep3: Collect all the slices of bread, jam, butter, and other cooking ingredients to score high.
HomeFeatures.feature1Description: Enjoy lifelike sounds and irresistibly engaging gameplay.
HomeFeatures.feature2Description: Zip through challenging levels with a running toaster.
HomeFeatures.feature3Description: Use points earned to upgrade the toaster and complete levels faster.
HomeFeatures.feature4Description: Become a genius master chef by completing missions and optimizing your score.
